name: b5_400m_v1
lr_schedule: linear warm-up 5% of total steps, then linear decay
checkpoint_rule: minimum mean validation loss; patience 3 epochs; compare loss to loss (not perplexity)
notes: Generic train_HyenaTransgenic.py and the GB10 script default to the 1.17B wide config (1152/16/8) and must not be used for B5 without loading this file. The RTX4090 script config (encoder 256/8, decoder 1536/24, 7 epochs, lr 2e-5) is a different experiment and is not the B5 recipe.
